I'm Micah Zhou, a Junior at Emerald High School in Dublin, CA. My focus is on game design — a field sitting right at the intersection of computer science, art, and storytelling. I want to build experiences people lose themselves in.

Over the past couple of years, I've gotten deep into graphic design — specifically anime-style headers and visual compositions in Photoshop. I've built up a portfolio on Behance showcasing that work, blending cinematic framing with digital manipulation to create visuals that actually hit.

On the development side, I build games in Roblox Studio using Luau and Lua. I also run a YouTube gaming channel (@Tenjin1) that has grown to over 40K subscribers. I'm also proficient in Java, Python, and have experience with 3D modeling in Blender.

Academically I push myself hard — 5 APs total across high school, with AP Calc AB, AP CSA, and AP Lang this year alongside Mandarin 4 Honors and Honors Physics. Previously completed AP CSP and AP Precalc. I've played basketball for six-plus years, along with baseball, football, soccer, hockey, and volleyball.

Projects.exe

ACTIVE // GAME DEV

Roblox Game Development

Independent Project 2022 – Present Game Design

Objective: Design and publish original, playable games on the Roblox platform, building every system from the ground up — mechanics, environments, scripting, and UI.

My Responsibilities: I served as the sole developer and designer on all projects. My work included 3D environment building in Roblox Studio, programming gameplay logic and systems using Luau and Lua, designing user interfaces, and playtesting to refine the player experience.

What I Learned: I gained hands-on experience with the full game development pipeline — from concept to launch. I learned how to structure scalable code, iterate quickly on feedback, and manage a creative project independently over an extended period.

Skills Exemplified: Luau/Lua scripting, 3D environment design, game systems design, Blender modeling, and creative direction.

COMPLETE // WEB APP

Virtual Study Buddy

CSE Course — Emerald High School Mar – May 2024 Solo

Objective: Build a student productivity web app that structures study and break intervals using a timer system, and tracks long-term academic goals to help students stay organized and motivated.

My Responsibilities: I designed and built the full application independently after taking on the project solo. This included planning the UI layout, writing all HTML/CSS/JS code, implementing the timer logic, and testing the app to ensure it worked reliably across use cases.

What I Learned: I learned how to manage a complete software project on my own, from design through deployment. I strengthened my JavaScript skills — especially working with timers and state — and improved my ability to produce polished, user-friendly interfaces under a deadline.

Skills Exemplified: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, UI/UX design, independent project management, problem-solving, and web development best practices.
